ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle BAC=95^\circ$, $\angle B=25^\circ$, $\angle CAD=75^\circ$, determine the measure of $\angle ADC$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle BAC=95^\circ$ and $\angle CAD=75^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BAD=\angle BAC-\angle CAD=20^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle B=25^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle ADC=\angle ABC+\angle BAD=25^\circ+20^\circ=\boxed{45^\circ}$.
